collection.title: Audi A8 Non-Integrated Washer Jets 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A8 2018 Onwards model which requires a 27" wiper blade for the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Fitting arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE: These blades specifically designed for models without the Integrated Washer Jets. If you have the Integrated Washer Jet system will require these: https://www.wiperblades.co.uk/audi-a8-years-2018-to-2022-wiper-blades
